mapper.sql: s.id, s.homework_id, s.student_id, s.content, s.status, s.create_time, s.update_time, s.score, s.answer_data, s.grading_data, 'submission' AS owner_type
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO homework_submission (homework_id, student_id, content, status, score, answer_data, grading_data) VALUES (#{homeworkId}, #{studentId}, #{content}, #{status}, #{score}, #{answerData}, #{gradingData})
mapper.select: SELECT , SUBSTRING(u.username, LOCATE('_', u.username) + 1) AS student_name FROM homework_submission s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.student_id = u.id WHERE s.id = #{id}

SELECT , SUBSTRING(u.username, LOCATE('_', u.username) + 1) AS student_name FROM homework_submission s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.student_id = u.id WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY update_time DESC

SELECT , SUBSTRING(u.username, LOCATE('_', u.username) + 1) AS student_name FROM homework_submission s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.student_id = u.id WHERE s.homework_id = #{homeworkId} ORDER BY update_time DESC

SELECT , SUBSTRING(u.username, LOCATE('_', u.username) + 1) AS student_name FROM homework_submission s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.student_id = u.id WHERE s.homework_id = #{homeworkId} AND s.student_id = #{studentId}
